interest: 1930s worries about Japanese threats to the Panama Canal.
overview: This file (State Department decimal file 894.20211F) comprises administrative charge slips, document cross-reference sheets, and an internal memorandum spanning 1931 to 1938 concerning Japanese military affairs, espionage, and surveillance in the Panama Canal Zone and the Republic of Panama. It indexes inter-agency communications, including a 1932 Department of Justice report regarding an alleged Japanese conspiracy to dynamite the Panama Canal discovered by Herbert Wilcox, a 1933 despatch cross-reference from Santo Domingo, and a 1936 War Department request for diplomatic cooperation in monitoring Japanese espionage activities near the canal. The file also preserves an internal 1931 handwritten note to Far Eastern Division chief Dr. Stanley K. Hornbeck discussing departmental division jurisdiction and the Senate's secret 1924 deliberations surrounding the Lodge Resolution.
